data_directory = '../ProjectData/data_cleaning/final_cleaned_data_files'

nhanes_kidney_df = pd.read_csv(f'{data_directory}/nhanes_kidney_cleaned.csv')

kidney = nhanes_kidney_df.copy()
#kidney = kidney.drop(columns=["SEQN"], errors="ignore")

features_kidney = [
    "LBXSCR",
    "LBXSBU",
    "LBXSAL",
    "LBXSPH",
    "LBXSKSI",
    "URXUMA",
    "URXUCR",
    "URDACT",
]

X_k = kidney[features_kidney]
y_k = kidney["ckd_label"]

#loading diabetes data for biomarkers

nhanes_diabetes_df = pd.read_csv(f'{data_directory}/nhanes_diabetes_cleaned.csv')

diabetes = nhanes_diabetes_df.copy()
#diabetes = diabetes.drop(columns=["SEQN"], errors="ignore")

features_diabetes = [
    "LBXGH",
    "LBDGLUSI",
    "LBDHDD",
    "LBXIN",
]

X_d = diabetes[features_diabetes]
y_d = diabetes["diabetes_label"]

#loading cardio data --> found an NHANES biomarkers dataset

nhanes_cardio_df = pd.read_csv(f'{data_directory}/nhanes_cardio_cleaned.csv')
cardio = nhanes_cardio_df.copy()
#cardio = cardio.drop(columns=["SEQN"], errors="ignore")

cardio["SBP_AVG"] = cardio[
    ["BPXOSY1", "BPXOSY2", "BPXOSY3"]
].mean(axis=1)

cardio["DBP_AVG"] = cardio[
    ["BPXODI1", "BPXODI2", "BPXODI3"]
].mean(axis=1)

features_cardio = [
    "LBDHDD",      # HDL
   # "LBXTC",       # Total Cholesterol
    "LBXTR",       # Triglycerides
    #"LBXHSCRP",    # hs-CRP
    #"SBP_AVG",     # Average systolic BP
    "DBP_AVG"      # Average diastolic BP
]

cardio["cardio_label"] = (
    (cardio["LBDLDL"] >= 130) |
    (cardio["LBXTC"] >= 240) |
    (cardio["SBP_AVG"] >= 140) |
    (cardio["LBXHSCRP"] >= 3)
).astype(int)

X_c = cardio[features_cardio]
y_c = cardio["cardio_label"]

# decision tree function to easily implement multiple variables / datasets

def run_decision_tree(df, features, target, title):

    X = df[features]
    y = df[target]

    #split --> training and test

    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size = 0.4, random_state=42, stratify=y)

    tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth = 4, min_samples_leaf = 20, random_state = 42)

    tree.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = tree.predict(X_test)

    #report:
    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

    
    print("Decision tree for", title)
    print("Accuracy score:",  accuracy)
    print("Classification report")
    print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred))
    print("Confusion matrix")
    print(confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred))

    plt.figure(figsize=(28,10))
    plot_tree(tree,feature_names=features, class_names=["0","1"], filled = True)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.show()

    importance_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "Feature": X.columns,
    "Importance": tree.feature_importances_
    }).sort_values("Importance", ascending=False)
    
    print(importance_df)

    return tree

diabetes_df = diabetes.copy()
kidney_df = kidney.copy()
cardio_df = cardio.copy()

diabetes_df = diabetes_df.rename(columns={c: f"dia_{c}" for c in features_diabetes})
kidney_df   = kidney_df.rename(columns={c: f"kid_{c}" for c in features_kidney})
cardio_df   = cardio_df.rename(columns={c: f"car_{c}" for c in features_cardio})

diabetes_features_r = [f"dia_{c}" for c in features_diabetes]
kidney_features_r   = [f"kid_{c}" for c in features_kidney]
cardio_features_r   = [f"car_{c}" for c in features_cardio]

diabetes_df = diabetes_df.rename(columns={"diabetes_label": "dia_diabetes_label"})
kidney_df   = kidney_df.rename(columns={"ckd_label": "kid_ckd_label"})
cardio_df   = cardio_df.rename(columns={"cardio_label": "car_cardio_label"})

pathway_df = (
    diabetes_df[["SEQN"] + diabetes_features_r + ["dia_diabetes_label"]]
    .merge(kidney_df[["SEQN"] + kidney_features_r + ["kid_ckd_label"]], on="SEQN", how="inner")
    .merge(cardio_df[["SEQN"] + cardio_features_r + ["car_cardio_label"]], on="SEQN", how="inner")
)

print("Merged pathway dataset shape:", pathway_df.shape)
print("Respondents lost to inner join (diabetes):", len(diabetes_df) - len(pathway_df))
print("Respondents lost to inner join (kidney):  ", len(kidney_df) - len(pathway_df))
print("Respondents lost to inner join (cardio):  ", len(cardio_df) - len(pathway_df))


pathway_features_all = diabetes_features_r + kidney_features_r + cardio_features_r
impute_pathway = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
pathway_df[pathway_features_all] = impute_pathway.fit_transform(pathway_df[pathway_features_all])
